topic.title: Communication: The Story in Community Information Networks

candidate_instructions: Read all five sections. Answer Questions 1-5. Follow the stated word limits exactly.

sections.heading: The Beginning
sections.text: A multilingual public information service started six months ago. Many immigrants did not understand important health and legal information. Volunteers translated health leaflets and held information meetings. They recruited bilingual community members to help. Now, information is available in eight languages.

sections.heading: How It Works
sections.text: The project works five days each week. It helps many people in the community. Workers and volunteers are there every day..

sections.heading: People's Stories
sections.text: More and more people come each month. The project is now very popular. Everyone says it is a good thing..

sections.heading: Good and Bad
sections.text: Some things are difficult. There is not enough money. We need more helpers. But people still believe in the work..

sections.heading: The Future
sections.text: The project will grow in the future. More services will start. More people will benefit..

passage.full_text:
Paragraph 1 — The Beginning
A multilingual public information service started six months ago. Many immigrants did not understand important health and legal information. Volunteers translated health leaflets and held information meetings. They recruited bilingual community members to help. Now, information is available in eight languages.

Paragraph 2 — How It Works
The project works five days each week. It helps many people in the community. Workers and volunteers are there every day..

Paragraph 3 — People's Stories
More and more people come each month. The project is now very popular. Everyone says it is a good thing..

Paragraph 4 — Good and Bad
Some things are difficult. There is not enough money. We need more helpers. But people still believe in the work..

Paragraph 5 — The Future
The project will grow in the future. More services will start. More people will benefit..
